title: Ethiopian Stew Recipe
description: A hearty and flavorful Ethiopian stew made with fish, vegetables, and spices.

ingredients.name: ethiopian spices
ingredients.notes: berbere, cumin, coriander, garlic powder, salt and black pepper

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook for a further 5 minutes.
Add the fish florets and cook until they start to flake, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the berbere spice mix and cook for a further minute.
Add the sliced carrots and cook until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Season with salt, black pepper, cumin, coriander, and garlic powder.
Simmer the stew for 10-12 minutes or until the fish is cooked through and the carrots are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
